title: Map region highlight
description: Use to call out a country by ISO code on a world map: it lights up and the camera eases toward it (offline). The label sits on the country.
props: {code?: string /*'ITA' (ISO alpha-3 or alpha-2)*/; label?: string /*country name*/; zoom?: number /*0.5*/; landColor?: string; strokeColor?: string; highlightColor?: string /*'#38bdf8'*/; textColor?: string; startFrame?: number /*10*/; durationInFrames?: number /*40*/; fontFamily?: string}
